target_fidelity.note: The target is present perfect progressive, active, positive, declarative, with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target sentence is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The ongoing-action context and answer are coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It gives focused practice of the present perfect progressive with a duration phrase.

determinacy.note: “Started ... an hour ago” and “still doing it” clearly cue “has been washing.”

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and situation are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt does not display the completed target form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated advanced grammar is needed to solve it.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is required.
